title: gameWorkspaceSection
responsibility: Selects the workspace section allowed by the current level plan.

inputs.name: gameWorkspaceSection.view
inputs.description: The current level; undefined is treated the same as a level whose planning is unset. Only view.planning decides whether the plan branch applies, and LevelValidator.isReady(view) runs only for a planned level's section that is neither Level nor Mechanics.

examples.title: The courtyard
examples.style: Lush illustrated garden, warm stone, soft sunlight. Preserve the player, key and door positions.

examples.title: The courtyard
examples.style: Lush illustrated garden, warm stone, soft sunlight. Preserve the player, key and door positions.

planning.concept: Walled garden with the key on a raised ledge
planning.description: The player climbs to the key, then reaches the door on the far wall.

inputs.name: gameWorkspaceSection.tab
inputs.description: The section the caller requests. With no plan only Level changes, to Checkpoints; with a plan, Mechanics and Level are kept, and any other section is kept only when LevelValidator.isReady(view) is true, otherwise it becomes Level.

outputs.name: gameWorkspaceSection
outputs.description: The section the workspace shows: the requested tab when it is kept; with a plan, Level for a Level request or for any non-Mechanics tab while LevelValidator.isReady(view) is false; with no plan, Checkpoints for a Level request.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Any exception raised while reading view.planning or inside LevelValidator.isReady(view) is not caught and propagates unchanged.
